title: Turbofan RUL: Gradient Boosting vs. Tabular Foundation Model
synopsis: An alternative take on the C-MAPSS Remaining Useful Life problem: put HistGradientBoostingRegressor head to head with TabICL, a pre-trained tabular foundation model that predicts by in-context learning. One skore.evaluate comparison with grouped cross-validation over engines shows the foundation model winning on accuracy and steadiness while costing a hundredfold more per prediction, and a data-efficiency curve over the number of run-to-failure engines shows how few broken machines each model needs.
